laws: Measured where measured. Reconstructed where necessary. Never invented.
Representation can exceed the source. Knowledge claims cannot exceed the evidence.
purpose: Compare the current source-bound measurement interpretation and an admitted calibration-assisted interpretation side by side without feeding calibrated values into the production Scientific Master route.
requiredInputs: calibration measurement-model parameters bound to that exact binding
raw sample plus CFA phase/color and existing source gain-field value

noiseRule.calibrated: sigma_cal = sqrt(max(S_cal * max(preGainCalibratedSignal,0) + O_cal,0)) * responseScale * sourceGainField

censorRule.darkNoiseLimited: max(signal,0) <= snrThreshold * sigma when sigma is available

forbiddenV0_1: writing shadow values into the Scientific Master
per-channel response scaling without independent color calibration
using worker count to select or alter calibration
using product HDR appearance to trigger another ISO/gain interpretation
partialCalibrationRule: A parameter not independently admitted remains source-bound; the shadow branch may mix calibrated and source-bound parameters only when each changed parameter is explicitly enabled and bound by the admitted model.
shadowOutputs: summary counts and max/mean absolute delta
